In the background, modern city buildings and a stone riverbank lined with a crowd of human spectators are visible under bright, natural daylight. (2) As the camera follows the boats, the lead boat, adorned with a colorful, ornate dragon head at the bow, pulls slightly ahead. The cats' facial expressions appear focused and determined, with their mouths slightly open as if chanting. The water surface is highly dynamic, with turbulent wakes trailing behind the vessels. The lighting remains consistent, casting soft shadows on the riverbank. (3) The sequence continues with the boats moving swiftly past the viewers. One orange-and-white cat in the back of the leading boat stands up with paws raised in a cheering gesture. The crowd on the banks is visible as a blur of colorful clothing, standing behind a metal railing. The video concludes with the boats maintaining their high-speed pursuit down the waterway.
